evidence.text:
桓公北征經金城見前為琅邪時種柳皆已十圍慨
然曰木猶如此人何以堪攀枝執條泫然流淚

謝太傅絶重褚公常稱禇季野雖不言而四時之氣
亦備

review.explanation: The mention 桓公 in the candidate evidence text describes 桓溫's northern expedition (北征) passing 金城, recalling willows planted when he was 琅邪內史. This is a well-known anecdote about 桓溫 from the Shishuo Xinyu. The alias registry matches 桓公 to 桓溫, and the contextual content (北征, 金城, 琅邪) is consistent with 桓溫's biography. The reference semantics indicate low confidence and no anchor mentions, but the evidence text itself is specifically about 桓溫's famous willow anecdote. No contradicting evidence is present.

謝太傅 is the standard office-title reference to 謝安 (who held the office of 太傅). The main text (sfh1-ev-06-yaliang-033-main) explicitly uses 謝太傅 in a narrative where he meets 謝安南 (謝奉) on the road, and the reference semantics confirm coreference with another mention and distinctness from 謝奉. The candidate evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-32da068eb14777549427) also uses 謝太傅 in a context consistent with 謝安. The office title 太傅 uniquely identifies 謝安 in this period. No contradicting evidence exists.

assertions.exact_span: 謝安南免吏部尚書還東
assertions.interpretation: The scene opens with Xie Annan (Xie Feng) having been dismissed from the post of Minister of Personnel and returning eastward; this dismissal and return constitute the initiating event of the narrative.
assertions.surface: 謝安南免吏部尚書還東

assertions.interpretation: The two men met at Pogang; this meeting point and moment is the central scene time of the narrative.

assertions.exact_span: 既當逺别遂停三日共語
assertions.interpretation: Because they were about to part for a long distance, they stopped together and conversed for three days; the three-day duration defines the temporal span of the encounter.
assertions.surface: 既當逺别遂停三日共語

assertions.interpretation: After the journey, the Taifu harbored deep regret that his feelings had not been fully expressed; this is a later emotional outcome following the three-day encounter.

assertions.exact_span: 謂同舟曰謝奉故是竒士
assertions.interpretation: The Taifu later remarked to his fellow boat passengers that Xie Feng was indeed an extraordinary man; this remark occurs after the encounter, during the continued journey.
assertions.surface: 謂同舟曰謝奉故是竒士

assertions.exact_span: 歷安南將軍廣州剌史吏部尚書
assertions.interpretation: The annotation records that Xie Feng successively held the offices of Annan General, Governor of Guangzhou, and Minister of Personnel; this provides the chronological sequence of his official career.
assertions.surface: 歷安南將軍廣州剌史吏部尚書

assertions.exact_span: 祖端散騎常侍父鳯丞相主簿
assertions.interpretation: The annotation gives genealogical background: his grandfather Duan was a Sanqi Changshi and his father Feng was a Chancellor's Registrar; this is background information predating the scene.
assertions.surface: 祖端散騎常侍父鳯丞相主簿

assertion.exact_span: 謝太傅赴桓公司馬出西
assertion.interpretation: Xie Taifu (Xie An) was traveling west to take up the post of Sima under Huan Wen; this westward journey is contemporaneous with the meeting, providing the occasion for the encounter.
assertion.surface: 謝太傅赴桓公司馬出西

assertion.exact_span: 雖信宿中塗竟不言及此事
assertion.interpretation: Even though they stayed overnight (信宿) along the way, Xie Annan never once mentioned the matter of his dismissal during the entire journey; this describes the temporal extent of the silence.
assertion.surface: 雖信宿中塗竟不言及此事
